provider: Science Data Bank (ScienceDB, Chinese Academy of Sciences / CNIC)

free_tier.stated: Allowance is 1 TB per dataset and 2,000 files per dataset with no published per-user or per-account cap. The 1 TB limit is a soft threshold requiring administrator coordination for larger submissions. Data packages bundle multiple datasets under one published record.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Free public HTTPS download; no egress accounting in any policy page read.

tooling: Web upload plus an Open API and OAI-PMH (listed in the help centre nav). No S3 backend exposed, so bulk automation is upload-by-UI or the Open API.
chaining: Unlimited datasets x 1 TB each is the stated model; data packages then group them. This is the one Chinese academic repository that needs no +86 phone, no Alipay and no real-name verification - registration accepts username/password, GitHub, ORCID or WeChat, and only the first two are needed.
limits_note: Review gate before publication; upload UI is the practical path (no public write API found for bulk); 2,000-file soft cap per dataset.
reliability_note: Operated by CNIC with Springer Nature recommended repository status. Single-stream network throughput outside mainland China is unmeasured.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

extras.agent_focus: Bulk data programmes that pay for your storage. Two halves: (1) institutional/gov repositories and cloud open-data sponsorships, judged as free byte pools; (2) research grants that could fund storage for an unaffiliated individual. Revisited AWS ODS, Google Cloud public datasets, Source Cooperative. Central question for each: what is the unit of quota (account / record / dataset / collection / project), because that unit is the multiplier.

binding_note: the write is a queue with a person or a rule in it, so the upload rate is set by somebody else
